_comment: ⚑ The one conversant that MOVES (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3b-ii, D22): every other NPC ships speed 0, so without this the hold — an actor in conversation stops walking and resumes after — would be shipped blind, exercised by nothing. speed 0.5 × idleSpeedFactor 0.35 ≈ 0.29 units/s, a stroll roughly half a chasing Orc; the short dwell (1–3 s vs the 3–10 s default) is deliberate, because an NPC that stands still a third of the time makes 'it stopped to talk' unprovable. ⚑ collisionMask 80 = MobStatic(64) + Border(16), the moving-mob default: the other 13 author 16 because a stationary NPC never needed to notice a tree. All movement values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ wanderRadius also RANDOMISES THE SPAWN POINT — MobSystem.spawnAt offsets the authored position by randomInDisc(wanderRadius) — so this NPC starts up to 4 units off (-15.53, 30.68) and wanders 4 more. It is never where the zone file says, which matters for anyone (or any harness) trying to find it. Waypoints on the spawn are the alternative if a road route reads better than an amble, and they would also pin the start. — Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (chunk 3a): formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ R4 C1 (plan-downtime.md D7/D8, 2026-08-03): the Recall teaching is GONE — Recall is a baseline utility every character holds from creation, so the wanderer currently teaches nothing; the teachings node was deleted WITH its root row, because the empty-destination prune deliberately spares an authored-empty node (it reads as a lore leaf). New teachings are ordinary later content. The zone entry called it 'Wanderer_1'; the suffix was placement bookkeeping, not a name.
name: Wanderer

lines: North, through the tunnel. Bring a light.
East is dangerous. Bandits watch that road.
